value_flows.description: Value (offer_asset.amount) flows into compute_swap which calculates return_amount, spread_amount, swap_fee_amount, protocol_fee_amount, burn_fee_amount, extra_fees_amount. No state mutation occurs in queries, but this simulates token movement.
In reverse simulation for ConstantProduct, ask_asset.amount flows into compute_offer_amount to derive offer_amount, spread_amount, fees. Simulates reverse token movement.

In reverse simulation for StableSwap, ask_asset.amount is adjusted for fees (before_fees), then used to calculate new_offer_pool_amount via calculate_stableswap_y, from which offer_amount is derived. Simulates reverse token movement with amplification factor.
In simulate_swap_operations, offer_amount flows through a chain of query_simulation calls, each updating amount based on return_amount. This simulates value flow across multiple pools.

In reverse_simulate_swap_operations, ask_amount flows through a reversed chain of query_simulation calls, each updating amount based on return_amount. This simulates reverse value flow across multiple pools.
Token swap computation: offer tokens -> ask tokens after fees
Fee calculation and distribution
LP token mint amount calculation for stableswap deposits
Pool invariant D calculation
Stableswap Y calculation
Swap computation calculates return_amount, burn_fee_amount, protocol_fee_amount, swap_fee_amount, spread_amount from offer_asset and pool reserves
Pool balance update: offer_asset.amount added to offer asset pool, return_asset.amount + outgoing_fees subtracted from ask asset pool
Fees (burn_fee_asset, protocol_fee_asset, swap_fee_asset) separated from return_asset for external handling

provide_liquidity: User sends assets (deposits). For single-sided: half swapped via internal swap submessage, then liquidity provision via reply. For dual-sided: assets added to pool, LP minted to user (or locked in farm_manager). Pool state (assets) incremented.
order_of_operations: 2. Single-sided path: simulate swap, store buffer, execute swap submessage
3. Dual-sided path: compute share, assert slippage, mint LP (or lock)

value_flows.description: withdraw_liquidity: User burns LP tokens. Proportional pool assets calculated and sent via BankMsg::Send. Pool assets decremented. LP tokens burned.
order_of_operations: 2. Verify LP token payment, compute share_ratio

value_flows.description: Initial token balances created via mock bank keeper for test accounts
Pool manager instantiation with creation fee configuration
Liquidity provision transfers tokens from sender to pool
Swap transfers offer tokens to pool and receives ask tokens
Liquidity withdrawal transfers LP tokens back to underlying assets
Configuration update changes contract addresses and parameters
Farm manager config update changes pool manager reference

value_flows.operation: User sends offer_asset (e.g., uatom) to contract via MessageInfo.funds. Contract performs sequential swaps via perform_swap, accumulating swap_result.return_asset, burn_fee_asset, protocol_fee_asset. Final return_asset is sent to receiver via BankMsg::Send. Fees are sent to fee_collector_addr or burned. Value order: 1) input tokens locked in contract, 2) each swap transforms tokens, 3) fees deducted, 4) final output transferred to receiver.

User sends pool_creation_fee (and token factory denom creation fee) via MessageInfo.funds. Contract creates a new pool with zero balances, creates LP token denom via tokenfactory::create_denom. No immediate value transfer beyond fees. Value order: 1) fees collected and sent to fee_collector_addr, 2) pool metadata stored, 3) LP denom created but not minted.
Owner updates config: fee_collector_addr, farm_manager_addr, pool_creation_fee, feature_toggle. No direct value transfer, but changes how future fees are collected and which features are enabled.

value_flows.description: Farm creation: create_farm_fee transferred from sender to fee_collector
Position creation: LP tokens locked in contract via ManagePosition::Create
Farm rewards distribution: calculated per epoch based on emission_rate and curve
Position withdrawal: LP tokens returned after unlocking duration, possible penalty for emergency unlock
Pool creation: pool_creation_fee collected from user, LP tokens minted upon ProvideLiquidity

ProvideLiquidity: user deposits token_in/token_out, receives LP tokens. LP tokens may be locked via farm_manager. Order: validate inputs -> check balances -> calculate shares -> transfer tokens -> mint LP -> optionally lock LP
Swap: user sends token_in, receives token_out. Fees deducted from output. Order: validate pool -> calculate swap amounts -> deduct fees -> transfer token_in to pool -> transfer token_out to receiver
WithdrawLiquidity: user burns LP tokens, receives underlying assets. Order: validate LP -> calculate share -> calculate withdrawal amounts -> burn LP -> transfer assets
ExecuteSwapOperations: chained swaps where output of one swap becomes input of next. Final amount checked against minimum_receive
UpdateConfig: admin changes fee_collector_addr, farm_manager_addr, pool_creation_fee, feature_toggle
burn_coin_msg: creates BankMsg::Burn to permanently remove tokens from supply
Token creation fee burned during MsgCreateDenom execution, using configured fee amount and denom
Tokens minted to specified address via BankSudo::Mint during MsgMint execution
Tokens burned from sender via BankMsg::Burn during MsgBurn execution
